# Metal complex builder references

Independent references for `apps/desktop/src/lib/molecular-workbench/metal-complex.ts`
(see [docs/metal-complex-builder.md](../../../docs/metal-complex-builder.md)).

| File | Content | Origin and license |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `complexes.json` | Builder requests, COD entry per complex, stated tolerances | Burette (MIT) |
| `samples/*.sdf` | Exact builder output for each request | Burette (MIT); regenerated by `build-samples.ts` |
| `reference.json` | RDKit and Open Babel read-back of the samples, COD coordination spheres, Avogadro center-template angles, Open Babel covalent radii | Derived numbers; COD data are CC0, Avogadro templates BSD-3-Clause |
| `build-samples.ts`, `reference.py` | The two generators | Burette (MIT) |

## Commands

```sh
git clone https://github.com/OpenChemistry/avogadrolibs.git /tmp/avogadrolibs-stage7   # commit 064eeb4706877ffed8ddc4b037489ed3748b0547
mkdir -p /tmp/metal-stage7/cod
bun tests/fixtures/metal-complex/build-samples.ts
cd tests/fixtures/metal-complex
uv run --python 3.12 --with rdkit==2025.9.1 --with openbabel-wheel==3.1.1.22 --with gemmi==0.7.5 \
  python reference.py /tmp/metal-stage7/cod /tmp/avogadrolibs-stage7 064eeb4706877ffed8ddc4b037489ed3748b0547
```

Tools recorded in `reference.json`: Python 3.12.12, RDKit 2025.09.1, Open Babel 3.1.0
(`openbabel-wheel` 3.1.1.22), gemmi 0.7.5. `reference.py` downloads each CIF from
`https://www.crystallography.net/cod/<id>.cif` into the cache directory; coordination spheres are
built from all symmetry images of the donor sites within the cutoff in `complexes.json`.

## Tolerances and measured deviations

Sorted donor–metal–donor angles are compared index by index; the number of trans angles (≥ 135°)
must match exactly.

- Monodentate complexes, 7°: largest deviations are Cu 6.7° (Cu above the basal plane of the
  Jahn–Teller square pyramid), Zn 5.4°, Fe(CO)5 3.9°, cisplatin 2.6°, others ≤ 2.1°.
- Tris-chelates, 12° overall and 5° on the chelate bite angles: [Fe(ox)3] 10.8° (crystal trigonal
  twist, trans 163–164° against 174°), [Fe(acac)3] 5.9°, [Co(en)3] 5.4°, [Ru(bpy)3] 1.8°; bites differ
  by en 4.3° (the rigid en template has a 2.77 Å N···N span), acac 2.4°, ox 1.2°, bpy 0.8°. Chelate
  samples use the crystal mean M–D distance because the bite follows from it.
- Default metal–donor distances (Cordero covalent-radius sums) are within 0.25 Å of the crystal mean
  for each donor element: Fe–CO 0.21 Å and Ru–bpy 0.11 Å are the largest; the Jahn–Teller apical
  Cu–O (2.59 Å against 1.98 Å) is excluded.
- Ideal polyhedra match the Avogadro 2 center templates within 0.2°, except square pyramidal:
  Burette uses the vacant octahedron (90°/180°), Avogadro a C4v pyramid with 113°/133°.
